title: Cloudy sky
notes: Bright light-blue sky with soft white clouds drifting gently upward-left; no people, text or logos. Re-encoded for web: 1920x1080, H.264 crf 26, 25 fps, audio stripped, +faststart. Trimmed from the 18s source (1s-14s) and closed into a seamless 12s loop with a 1s crossfade, so the muted background loop in the hero has no visible cut. Poster is frame 0 of the final clip.
